drafted_from: tool row in tools/start-a-computer/tool-rows.json, read-data/providers.json, do-work/start-a-computer.mjs (priceOfAPlace) and tools/start-a-computer/test/start-a-computer.test.mjs
start_here: Say to your AI: "What would a cax11 machine at Hetzner cost me each month before I rent it?"
no_lists_because: It keeps no list: it reads a request file and the provider row's price request, and rents nothing.
instructions: 1. Write request.json with machine {provider: "hetzner", placement: {size: "cax11"}} (location, image and the rest come from the provider row).

2. Say the line in start_here. Your AI reads the row with tools:list {tool: "tool:read-a-computer-price"} and runs node tools/start-a-computer/do-work/start-a-computer.mjs price request.json with the vault credential hetzner-api-token handed on descriptor 3.
3. Read the JSON line: provider, placement and price {cents, currency}. A null price means the row reads none (a machine you already run with no price given).

worked_examples.title: The monthly price of a cax11 in the default location
worked_examples.ask: What does a cax11 cost per month?
worked_examples.given: From tools/start-a-computer/test/start-a-computer.test.mjs ('the price is the size\'s monthly price at the lease\'s location, in cents'): the provider answers GET /server_types?name=cax11 with prices fsn1 7.9900 and hel1 6.9900 (gross, EUR). request.json = {"machine":{"provider":"hetzner","placement":{"size":"cax11"}}}; hel1 is the row's default location. Run: node tools/start-a-computer/do-work/start-a-computer.mjs price request.json
worked_examples.hands_back: {"provider":"hetzner","placement":{"size":"cax11","location":"hel1","image":"ubuntu-24.04"},"price":{"cents":699,"currency":"EUR"}}: 6.99 EUR at hel1. With "location":"ash" the price is refused ("no monthly price") because the row lists none there.
